verdict.rationale: x402 is an HTTP payment protocol plus a hosted facilitator service. It is payment infrastructure that external AI agents use to discover and pay for services, not an end-user application with an interface where a built-in assistant would live. The evidence shows only agent-facing building blocks: agentic wallets for your own agent, MCP-based Bazaar discovery, and AgentCore connectors. None of these is a built-in AI assistant, so the story's axis does not fit this product type.
